description:
Service configuration. A service groups an upstream and plugins so multiple routes can share the same backend configuration.

Declarative service configuration. The optional `modifiedIndex` controls resource-level change detection with the YAML configuration provider.

update_time.description: Unix timestamp of last update. Read-only.

upstream_id.description: Reference to an existing Upstream resource.

enable_websocket.description: Enable WebSocket proxying for routes using this service.

modifiedIndex.description: Optional resource version used for change detection by the YAML configuration provider.
